hints.title: Relative Distance Decrement Equivalence
hints.text: Incrementing n minus one elements by one increases their values relative to the remaining element. Inverting perspective reveals a simpler relationship.

hints.title: Decreasing Towards Minimum Invariant
hints.text: Incrementing n minus one elements by one is mathematically equivalent to decrementing the single un-incremented element by one towards the array minimum.

hints.title: Minimum Distance Summation Procedure
hints.text: Find the minimum value across all elements in the array. Sum the difference between each element and this minimum value. Return the sum.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating increments step-by-step requires repeatedly finding maximum and updating elements in O(N * moves) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mathematical equivalence computes total moves in a single linear pass in O(N) time with O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should explain the mathematical duality: adding 1 to n - 1 elements is identical to subtracting 1 from one element.
